cim: Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max, its new flagship 2.4T-parameter MoE model with a 1M-token context window, saying it beats Qwen3.8-Max with up to ~50% fewer tokens (Qwen)

prioritas.cim_hu: Hivatalosan is megérkezett a 2,4 trillió paraméteres Qwen4-Max
